_comment: Authentication manifest version 2 retains all eight method identifiers.
Providers own shared settings and credential names. Methods own their model and endpoint settings.
User settings, active selections and unknown fields are preserved in $AGENTMUX_HOME/auth.json.
Credentials stay in the private local env store. Setup parses literal assignments and never sources that file.
Existing launchers still consume the export format. Scoped owner integration and native client qualification remain required.
Credential references contain names only. Values must never enter the browser, shared records, command arguments or logs.
Setup commands are instructions for the operator. The dashboard must never execute them.
Capability metadata distinguishes local configuration from live authentication and actual worker selection.

providers.label: ChatGPT account
providers.summary: A ChatGPT plan, via browser sign-in. The CLI owns the token; agentmux holds nothing.
notes: Plan limits and account eligibility are not established by local configuration.

providers.label: OpenAI API
providers.summary: Credential input for the OpenAI API. Live access and account terms are unqualified.

providers.label: Anthropic account
providers.summary: Interactive sign-in to a Claude plan.
notes: Native account authentication requires a qualified client-owned login check.

providers.label: Anthropic API
providers.summary: Credential input for the Anthropic API. Live access and account terms are unqualified.

providers.label: Google Vertex AI
providers.summary: GCP-hosted models. Credentials come from gcloud ADC, so there is no key for agentmux to hold.
notes: Nothing is stored in ~/.agentmux/env for this provider - the credential is the gcloud ADC file.

providers.label: xAI account
providers.summary: Retained method for CLI-managed xAI sign-in. The native sign-in flow is unqualified.
notes: The historical device-code command and account terms require current qualification.

providers.label: xAI API
providers.summary: API-key input for Grok. Client compatibility and account access are unqualified.

providers.label: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
providers.summary: An explicitly selected endpoint for the configured Responses API client.
notes: Responses API and client tool compatibility require qualification for the exact endpoint and client version.
For a separately approved local Bedrock gateway, CODEX_CUSTOM_API_KEY must match its local AGENTMUX_BEDROCK_GATEWAY_TOKEN. Never use AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK as the client token.
